hero.title: Your Ultimate TCG & Board Game Hub
hero.description: Cicados is the perfect place for your trading card games (TCG) and board games. Rent a fully equipped game table, participate in our weekly tournaments, and share unforgettable moments with a community of enthusiasts.

features.title: Our Key Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need to play at your best.

booking.title: Online Table Reservations
booking.description: Reserve your gaming space in just a few clicks. Choose the time, table, and duration for you and your friends.

tournaments.title: TCG Tournaments & Board Games
tournaments.description: Join our weekly competitive or friendly events. Take on the best players and win booster packs!

groups.title: Group-Friendly Spaces
groups.description: Giant, modular tables that are perfect for Commander games, drafts with friends, or your board game sessions.

how_it_works.title: How does it work?
how_it_works.subtitle: Three simple steps to join the community and start playing.

step_1.title: Choose your plan
step_1.description: Select the card game (MTG, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Pokémon...) or the table format you want.

step_2.title: Book your time slot
step_2.description: Select the date, time, and duration. Your table will be reserved instantly.

step_3.title: Sit back and play
step_3.description: Please check in at the reception desk on the day of the event. Your playmats and gaming accessories will already be set up!
